{{2023–24 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2023–24 Washington Huskies men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Washington]] in the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Huskies, led by seventh-year head coach [[Mike Hopkins (basketball)|Mike Hopkins]], played their home games at [[Hec Edmundson Pavilion|Alaska Airlines Arena at Hec Edmundson Pavilion]] in [[Seattle|Seattle, Washington]] as their last season as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 17–15, 9–11 in [[2023–24 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to finish in a three-way tie for sixth place. As the No. 8 seed in the [[2024 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]], they lost to [[2023–24 USC Trojans men's basketball team|USC]] in the first round.

On March 8, 2024, the school announced that head coach Mike Hopkins would be fired after the season.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-03-08 |title=Washington to fire Mike Hopkins: Huskies coach will be with team until end of season, won't be back in 2024-25 |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/washington-to-fire-mike-hopkins-huskies-coach-will-be-with-team-until-end-of-season-wont-be-back-in-2024-25/ |access-date=2024-03-27 |website=CBSSports.com |language=en}}</ref>  On March 25, the school named [[Utah State Aggies men's basketball|Utah State]] head coach [[Danny Sprinkle]] the team's new head coach.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-03-25 |title=Washington hires Danny Sprinkle from Utah State as men's basketball coach |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/washington-hires-danny-sprinkle-from-utah-state-as-mens-basketball-coach-182710031.html |access-date=2024-03-27 |website=Yahoo Sports |language=en-US}}</ref>

The season marked the final year for the school as a member of the Pac-12 conference. In August 2023, the school announced it would join the [[Big Ten Conference]] in 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-08-04 |title=Oregon, Washington join Big Ten: Programs depart Pac-12 in 2024 after serving as charter members since 1915 |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-football/news/oregon-washington-join-big-ten-programs-depart-pac-12-in-2024-after-serving-as-charter-members-since-1915/ |access-date=2024-03-27 |website=CBSSports.com |language=en}}</ref>

==Previous season==
The [[2022–23 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Huskies]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball rankings|2022–23 season]] 16–15, 8–12 in [[2022–23 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to tie for eighth place. They lost in the first round of the [[2023 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to [[2022–23 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Colorado]].
